what: hir_ty_suspend::on_fiber(db, krate) lists only FunctionIds (Def::Fn). blaze::blocking_on_pool (crates/blaze-lints/src/blaze/blocking_on_pool.rs) needs the closures that run on a fiber or pool thread too (e.g. the closure handed to the driver's spawn, its body is in the spawning function), so a blocking call written in `spawn(move || rx.recv())` is found. Ask: a fact listing the on-fiber closures (ClosureId or InferBodyId), or on_fiber returning the Def of each instance; blaze-lints will read it, not walk itself.
